_comment: AUTHORED Mom and Dad dialogue, three variants per key (PRD-v2 §8, locked decisions D7 + D8). Never LLM-generated. Tiers: spanish-first (bands 1-4, most support — the line is Spanish, English carries only the target word), bilingual (bands 5-6 — the whole line in Spanish, then the whole line in English), english-only (bands 7-10, least support — no Spanish scaffolding; character names stay). English increases monotonically across the tiers, never the other way. `{word}` is the only placeholder; the screen substitutes the current target word. Abuela (Spanish always, by design) and the baby's pre-baked babble are OUT OF SCOPE (PRD-v2 §8.3) — no abuela.* or baby.* keys belong in this file.

dad.fridge.prompt.fish.spanish-first: ¡Mija! Escríbele una nota a Mamá. Dile que trajimos... fish.
dad.fridge.prompt.fish.bilingual: Mija, escríbele una nota a Mamá: dile que trajimos pescado. Write a note for Mamá — tell her we got the fish!
dad.fridge.prompt.fish.english-only: Write a note for Mamá — tell her we got the fish! It was a little shellfish about coming home.

dad.fridge.prompt.beans.spanish-first: Dejémosle una notita a Mamá sobre los... beans.
dad.fridge.prompt.beans.bilingual: Dejémosle una notita a Mamá sobre los frijoles. Let's leave Mamá a little note about the beans!
dad.fridge.prompt.beans.english-only: Let's leave Mamá a note about the beans. I have bean waiting all day to say that.

dad.fridge.prompt.milk.spanish-first: En la nota para Mamá, escribe la palabra... milk.
dad.fridge.prompt.milk.bilingual: Escribe leche en la nota para Mamá. Can you write milk on the note for Mamá?
dad.fridge.prompt.milk.english-only: Can you write milk on the note for Mamá? Write it quick — we don't want this one to spoil.

dad.fridge.prompt.shop.spanish-first: Escribe en la nota dónde estuvimos: en el... shop.
dad.fridge.prompt.shop.bilingual: Escribe tienda en la nota, para que Mamá sepa dónde fuimos. Write shop on the note, so Mamá knows where we went!
dad.fridge.prompt.shop.english-only: Write shop on the note so Mamá knows where we went. We shopped till we dropped... the beans.

dad.fridge.prompt.stop.spanish-first: Tuvimos que parar en la tienda. Escribe... stop.
dad.fridge.prompt.stop.bilingual: Escribe alto en la nota — tuvimos que parar en la tienda. Write a note — we had to stop at the store!
dad.fridge.prompt.stop.english-only: Write a note — we had to stop at the store! And I could not stop thinking about dinner.

dad.fridge.prompt.the.spanish-first: Ahora la palabrita más importante de todas: the.
dad.fridge.prompt.the.bilingual: Escribe the — ¡es la palabra más importante de todas! Write the — it's the most important word of all!
dad.fridge.prompt.the.english-only: Write the — it's the most important word of all. The one, the only, the the!

dad.fridge.prompt.van.spanish-first: ¡Dile a Mamá que vimos una camioneta! Escribe... van.
dad.fridge.prompt.van.bilingual: Dile a Mamá que vimos una camioneta grande. Tell Mamá we saw a van — can you spell it?
dad.fridge.prompt.van.english-only: Tell Mamá we saw a van! Can you spell it? It van right past us.

dad.fridge.prompt.default.spanish-first: Escribe {word} en la nota para Mamá.
dad.fridge.prompt.default.bilingual: Escribe {word} en la nota para Mamá. Spell {word} on the note for Mamá!
dad.fridge.prompt.default.english-only: Spell {word} on the note for Mamá — she will appreciate it.

dad.fridge.success.bilingual: ¡Sí! {word}. ¡Qué bien lo hiciste, mija! Yes! {word}. You spelled it beautifully!
dad.fridge.success.english-only: Yes! {word}. That's exactly right — Mamá is going to love this note.

dad.fridge.goodnight.spanish-first: Uy... ¡a dormir, mija! Lo hiciste muy bien hoy.
dad.fridge.goodnight.bilingual: ¡A dormir, mija! Lo hiciste muy bien hoy. Off to bed — you did great today!
dad.fridge.goodnight.english-only: Off to bed! You did great today. Those notes are the best thing on that fridge.

mom.bedroom.arrival.spanish-first: Mija, ¿puedes leerle un cuento al hermanito? Se duerme mejor con tu voz.
mom.bedroom.arrival.bilingual: Mija, ¿puedes leerle un cuento al hermanito? Can you read a bedtime story to your baby brother?
mom.bedroom.arrival.english-only: Can you read a bedtime story to your baby brother? He sleeps best when he hears your voice.

mom.bedroom.goodnight.spanish-first: Buenas noches, hermanito. Buenas noches, mija.
mom.bedroom.goodnight.bilingual: Buenas noches, hermanito. Goodnight, little brother.
mom.bedroom.goodnight.english-only: Goodnight, little brother. Sweet dreams, you two.
